We were in a real bind with our Griha Pravesh just around the corner and some crucial carpentry tasks still pending due to an unforeseen issue with our previous carpenter. Thankfully, Rizwan Bhai (Mohammad Carpenter) came to our rescue, promptly sending over two of his skilled carpenters.

We were amazed at how efficiently they tackled our list of remaining jobs. Within just 2-3 hours, they expertly installed all the shelves, door magnets, and door handles, and even fitted the glass shelves perfectly. Their speed and expertise were truly a godsend on such a significant day for us.

Beyond their impressive workmanship, both carpenters were exceptionally polite and well-mannered. They worked diligently and showed great respect for our home. We are incredibly grateful to Rizwan Bhai for his swift response and the outstanding work of his team. Their professionalism and efficiency ensured our Griha Pravesh went off without a hitch. We wholeheartedly recommend their services!

featured_reviews.name: Minal Vasa
featured_reviews.review_text:
What all we things we consider while choosing a carpenter?

They should fit my budget.
They should work properly, (especially when we are living in the house during construction).
They should keep their promises.
They should do their work with honesty and listen to our concerns.

I usually don’t write reviews, but their work was so good that I had to. They finished everything on time without any delays and worked with honesty. I really liked how dedicated they were they put their heart into their work. They were also very polite and patient when answering my mom’s questions, unlike others who get irritated easily.

Thank you so much! I will definitely recommend them to others and would love to give them more contracts in the future without any hesitation.
